_comment: Survivor-count ratchet for the single mutmut 3 run: an increase fails the job (new code shipped without a test that kills its mutants), a decrease is a prompt to tighten. The number is OBSERVED, never predicted: 789 from CI workflow_dispatch run 36187698262 on rc 80a19c3 (7786 mutants, 10 timeouts); 791 after run 36558734128 (795 on rc 444a8c4) less three pragma-excused and two newly killed mutants, plus two equivalent ones from the finish-event subState read (int vs float converter) — re-observe on the next run. Equivalent mutants are carried here rather than killed; a line that is genuinely unobservable carries `pragma: no mutate` with its reason instead.
